_comment: Issue #1765: a rout keeps every man on his own slot, and the rally re-squares without scattering the block. Player Cavalry (uid 0, 18 horses on 5 files: 3 full ranks and a 3-horse short rank) starts facing south at (700, 500) and is quarter-turned right (E) at tick 12, so it faces west with a quarter-turn folded into its slot grid. A weak Infantry company (uid 1, 8 men) stands south of it. The enemy Cavalry (uid 2) charges the company, which breaks at tick 169; the contagion (12 morale off every friend within 140 wu) breaks the cavalry too, and uid 0 reads ROUTING from tick 170. The flight north snaps a quarter-turn more into the fold, a half-turn in all, and the cavalry rallies at tick 531, far from the fight. On main the rout dropped the fold, which swung the slot grid a quarter-turn about the anchor under the men: at tick 170 7 men's slots lay across the centreline from them and the farthest slot lay 160.0 wu sideways of its man (254.5 at tick 172), and the mean body-to-slot gap went from 0.0 to 180.4 wu (max 276.0). Here the rout moves no slot (0, 0.0, and a mean gap of 0.0). On main the rally then re-squared the quarter-turn fold the flight left, across the block (1 man across the centreline, 91.0 wu sideways, mean gap 42.7 to 115.4 wu, max 81.0 to 198.4). Here it re-squares a half-turn fold file by file, so no slot moves sideways and only the two short files' men step one rank (120 wu) forward (mean gap 5.8 to 43.5 wu, max 28.6 to 116.3). Expect tolerances: 0.5 wu at the rout is the float margin demos/README.md gives for slot_lateral_excess. At the rally the men carry a lateral lag from the flight (0.4 wu at tick 530 here), so 1.0 wu is the same 0.5 wu margin on top of a lag of up to 0.5 wu. Every expect below except the tick-8 pin and the two state claims fails on main.

shape_residual.reason: uid 2 is the enemy cavalry (48 horses, frontage 12). After the company breaks it marches north after it from about tick 400, and its horses fall behind their slots as it goes: mean body-to-slot gap 10.1 wu at tick 460, 22.7 at 500, 34.4 at 600 and 45.1 at 660. That is the long-pursuit drift tracked in #1716, and main does the same: over this script's own state ticks the shape_residual worst reads 41.03 on main e81ea9fa and 40.29 here, against a 30 wu threshold. Measured 2026-10-11.
